scope: Presentation aliases, not renamed model elements or inferred capabilities

ASMLCS_Control_if.basis: Cookbook 2011 §9.3.1 and interface name: Active Segmented Mirror Local Control System command/data interface

fpCtrlLan.basis: Source public port fpCtrlLan typed Ethernet-100Base-T_fs, with ASMLCS_Control_if allocated to it

fpImcsLan.basis: Source public Ethernet port fpImcsLan; IMCS refers to the InternalMetrology source context

imData.basis: Source imData typed IMData, allocated to the IMCS LAN port and TCP/IP; no payload fields inferred

ccs.basis: Source port ccs typed ASMProtocolStackA; control interface allocation. CCS abbreviation is not expanded

tcp/ip.basis: Source port tcp/ip typed TCP/IP; source data interface allocation

maintenance_header.basis: Human-readable display of the source scheduled-maintenance field; original PM notation retained in semantic source ledger without inventing an expansion
